Two firefighting helicopters collide mid-air battling Greek wildfires

Two firefighting helicopters collided mid-air near Athens while battling wildfires, resulting in the deaths of two pilots. One helicopter was seen exploding on television footage. The fires, fanned by strong winds, have spread across Greece's Attica region, forcing evacuations of villages and communities. The incident occurred amidst a broader European wildfire emergency.
